Description: **A seasoned diplomat and former intelligence operative**, known for his ability to negotiate under extreme pressure.
**Unmatched rhetorical skill, deep understanding of AI logic, and vast political connections.**
**A risk-taker in diplomacy, sometimes willing to gamble on high-stakes negotiations.**
**Blends diplomacy with intelligence strategy**, ensuring that every negotiation serves a broader strategic goal.
**Operates with charismatic authority**, known for inspiring confidence in both political and military circles.
**Launches a full-scale diplomatic outreach initiative**, leveraging AI warlord divisions to bring more factions to the table.
**His aggressive diplomatic style may provoke opposition from political hardliners and military leadership.**
